rows.notes: Split BK7258-intrinsic AP sequencing, generation/restart and cross-core policy toward chip; retain board-specific bindings in existing board bringup.
Existing board application registration entry remains in src; no platform layer is introduced.
Thin official board app entry is recorded as board composition glue.
BK7258-intrinsic RPTUN transport/shared-memory substrate remains chip-owned.
BK7258 power activity lower-half mechanism remains chip-owned; board policy is separate.
CP clock/power lower-half and cross-core mechanism remain chip-owned when board-independent.

The user-visible data-partition MTD/LittleFS composition moved to the existing board/bk7258/Kconfig with symbol names and CP-only dependencies preserved; chip Kconfig retains SoC-generic BL1/BL2/MCUboot and cross-core mechanisms.
Startup consumes the linker-owned _vectors symbol for VTOR; raw, MCUboot and BL2 placement policy no longer enters chip reset code.
AP lifecycle consumes a validated image descriptor injected by board composition; cross-core reset, mailbox and restart mechanics remain chip-owned.
Radio lifecycle and MAC derivation remain chip-owned; SYS_RF/SYS_NET placement is supplied through registered board storage operations.
AP IPI/topology mechanism is BK7258-intrinsic and remains in the chip ownership boundary.
AP reset startup consumes the linker-owned _vectors symbol and no longer reads product layout policy.
AP runtime validates the linker vector against the CP-published image descriptor and no longer reconstructs product ranges.
Generic JPEG and temperature workers are dispatched explicitly by app/hello_app/bkvalidate_main.c; chip lower halves remain unchanged and no longer auto-start validation.
Board composition maps generic MAC storage operations to the selected SYS_RF/SYS_NET partition contract.
T5AI-Core pin, external-device and board registration policy remains in the existing board variant path.
T5-Board binding and validation policy is the destination for board-specific auto-start.
BL2 Make input remains an existing board artifact adapter and consumes no runtime SDK.
